name: codeiq
description: A privacy-first understanding gate for AI-assisted coding.

codeiq.riskThreshold.description: Risk score at which CodeIQ recommends a short understanding checkpoint.

codeiq.lineCountSignal.description: Line count used as a starting signal, never as a sole checkpoint trigger.

codeiq.evaluationModel.description: Anthropic model used when live evaluation is enabled.

codeiq.useMockEvaluator.description: Use deterministic offline evaluation for demos and local development.

codeiq.sendCodeToLLM.description: Explicitly allow redacted code and your explanation to leave this machine for evaluation.

codeiq.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key. Prefer CODEIQ_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the extension host environment.

codeiq.enableVoiceInput.description: Enable optional Web Speech API input in the checkpoint panel.

codeiq.enableGitHook.description: Allow CodeIQ to install a non-blocking pre-commit warning hook.

codeiq.enableTelemetry.description: Opt in to anonymous usage analytics. Disabled by default.

codeiq.riskWeights.description: Optional JSON object overriding individual risk weights.
